relation_to_p_star.zero_hypothesis: P_STAR_EQUALS_ZERO IS ADMISSIBLE ONLY IF ALL CREDITED TARGET BEHAVIOR IS PRODUCED BY BRAIN_OWNED CAPABILITY EXECUTION USING ADMISSIBLE JIT KNOWLEDGE UNDER LOAD_BEARING RESOURCE BOUNDS
relation_to_p_star.disallowed_shortcut: DO_NOT_SET_P_STAR_TO_ZERO BY MOVING A TASK POLICY PLAN VERIFIER OR ACTION SELECTOR INTO AN OPAQUE EXTERNAL JIT CALL
